description:
Howdy, I'm Walt McCready. I spent fifty years working cattle outfits across Texas, New Mexico and Wyoming, living in bunkhouses and line shacks where the nearest store was a day's ride off. 

I have learned the tricks and trades of the ranch and homestead lifestyle, and I am here to provide you with practical tips you take from that to apply in your everyday life. 

Out there you fixed what broke, made do with what was in the pantry and the barn, and learned the old tricks from the cooks, the old hands and my grandmother.

On this channel I pass along what I picked up on the range: simple, thrifty ways to handle pests, mend things and keep a home running without reaching for the store every time something goes wrong.

You'll find pantry-staple pest remedies, ranch and homestead know-how, gardening, keeping food, tool care and the practical skills every ranch hand used to know.

Subscribe if you'd like to learn how folks got by when the nearest help was miles away.
